name: Graha
desc: Graha is a Vesperian NPC. They are a [Diver](faction:the_divers).
additional_info:
-   Graha's racial variant appears to be Besague.
-   Graha mentions how the stove next to them is the only way to cook anything in the [First Layer](location:first_layer). However, this is not true as there is also a stove in [The Chariot's Spire](location:the_chariots_spire), which they may not know about.
